text_block_list.text:
Relying on her own strength,
Matikanefukukitaru
makes her mark on
the Kokura Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As promised, she takes me to Fukuoka's
other
"sacred" spot—Hakata's street
food district.
There, she reveals there's a
certain race she hopes
to run in.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Instead of letting her fortune slips do
the honors,
Matikanefukukitaru chooses
to aim for the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She stokes her passion, determined to
earn her
spot on her own merits, unlike
what happened
with the Takarazuka
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
